policy.oneHost: Always inject into existing P01/P02/P04 native owner; never create second WPF/IPC/LLM host
policy.downloads: Manual owner-approved download only after exact commit/package/model license check and SHA-256. No automatic package install, network fetch or weights embedded by this manifest
policy.rights: Software license is not model weights license. Model cards and dataset rights must be checked independently.
policy.sourceFreeze: A candidate becomes active only after source fingerprint, owner receipt, native availability and real component tests on canonical PR162.
policy.crossPlatform: Windows owner-runtime source QA first. Web/mobile only through existing approved gateways.

candidates.name: whisper.cpp
candidates.role: P02 local RU/ES audio transcription alternative
candidates.integration: Existing local ASR owner port only

candidates.name: faster-whisper
candidates.role: P02 local RU/ES ASR alternative to whisper.cpp (choose ONE)
candidates.integration: Existing Python LocalVoicePipeline only, never parallel ASR

candidates.name: ComfyUI
candidates.role: Existing Creative Studio / P04 image/video inference backend
candidates.integration: Existing localhost ComfyUI worker /api/prompt/history/view through current NOX Creative bridge; check API compatibility; do not bundle GPL executable without owner review

candidates.name: Piper
candidates.integration: Optional external locally installed voice engine only; do not import archived rhasspy/piper MIT license as current OHF license

candidates.name: FFmpeg
candidates.codeLicense: LGPL-2.1+ by default; GPL-2+ if GPL components enabled
candidates.integration: Use existing installed ffmpeg executable only. Validate actual binary/version/configure flags and redistributability.
